subject: Cutover snapshot: ops runbook replay, KV warmup verification
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, ops@acme-corp.com
Cc: cloudinfra@partnercloud.io
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cutover snapshot: ops runbook replay, KV warmup verification

Team / Acme,

Quick plan for today’s handback and immediate post-cutover checks. We ran the runbook replay at 07:00 PT (dry run earlier this week) and will do the live runbook replay at 11:00 PT to exercise the ops bridge and the KV warmup path. Goals: 1) confirm traffic steering rules, 2) validate KV cache priming across the private cluster, 3) ensure observability hooks are present before 1st-hour traffic.

High-level checklist (will attach results):
- Bridge playbook steps 1–8 (auth, ACL verification, routing table check)
- KV warmup: targeted prefixes + supporting priming script (10k sample keys)
- Observability: span tagging, per-route latency SLI, token-level cost sampling enabled
- Fallback: model-variant routing test to Dedicated if capacity hit

Ask: Marissa / Marcus — can you own the runbook replay and attach the runbook-replay-log after the 11:00 run? Irene — please validate the observability checklist and call out any missing alert hooks. Acme — please confirm you can send a light 5 qps smoke from your side at 12:15 PT (will not be production traffic, just validation).

Attachments: runbook-template.pdf (referenced), priming-script.sh (stub)

Jonas
Jonas Weber
SRE Lead, Production Delivery
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acme-corp.com, cloudinfra@partnercloud.io
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover snapshot: ops runbook replay, KV warmup verification

Thanks Jonas — noted. Quick status and deviations from the dry run: 

- Runbook ownership: Marcus and I will run the steps. Marcus will take bridge steps, I’ll execute KV warmup.
- KV warmup change: the priming script now rotates prefixes every 5 minutes to avoid hot-shard patterns (updated in priming-script.sh). We’ll capture the key distribution in kv-warmup-report.csv.
- Observability: Irene, your checklist item #3 (per-route token sampling) was not enabled in the dry run. Can you flip that feature flag before 10:50 PT? We don't want blind spots during the first 15 minutes.

Plan for 11:00 PT runbook replay:
1) 11:00 — ops bridge echo + ACL verification (Marcus)
2) 11:10 — KV warmup live run (Marissa)
3) 11:30 — quick routing failover test to model-variant (non-prod traffic)
4) 12:00 — ingest runbook-replay-log.txt and share summary

I’ll attach the runbook-replay-log.txt and kv-warmup-report.csv after the run.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Ops Delivery Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Acme Ops <ops@acme-corp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: cloudinfra@partnercloud.io
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover snapshot: ops runbook replay, KV warmup verification

On Sun, 08 Aug 2027 at 10:05 -0700, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Thanks Jonas — noted. Quick status and deviations from the dry run:
> 
> - Runbook ownership: Marcus and I will run the steps. Marcus will take bridge steps, I’ll execute KV warmup.
> - KV warmup change: the priming script now rotates prefixes every 5 minutes to avoid hot-shard patterns (updated in priming-script.sh). We’ll capture the key distribution in kv-warmup-report.csv.

Thanks all — Acme will be ready for the 12:15 PT 5 qps validation. A couple of asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm the expected source IP ranges for the validation traffic? We’ve got strict egress filters and will allow only the listed ranges.
- Please include a small sample of the expected response schema in the runbook-replay-log so our parsing can be verified.

We’ll stand by in the channel and will post our results in the Ops bridge.

— Sam Patel
Head of Platform Ops, Acme Analytics
ops@acme-corp.com

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acme-corp.com, cloudinfra@partnercloud.io
Date: Sun, 08 Aug 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover snapshot: ops runbook replay, KV warmup verification

On Sun, 08 Aug 2027 at 11:22 -0700, Acme Ops wrote:
> Thanks all — Acme will be ready for the 12:15 PT 5 qps validation. A couple of asks from our side:
> - Can you confirm the expected source IP ranges for the validation traffic?
> - Please include a small sample of the expected response schema in the runbook-replay-log so our parsing can be verified.

Readout summary (11:00–12:10 PT):
- Bridge playback: PASS. ACL and BGP adjacencies verified. Marcus ran the route-checker; no asymmetric routes observed.
- KV warmup: PASS with caveats. Priming script rotated prefixes as planned; warmup covered 98% of targeted prefixes in 9m42s. See kv-warmup-report.csv (attached) for key distribution and latency percentiles.
- Observability: Minor gap fixed — token-sampling flag was enabled at 10:47 PT, capture started at 10:50 PT. Observability-checklist.pdf shows three alert hooks active; created JIRA OPS-3421 for one missing per-route alert (owner: telemetry).
- Failover test: routing to model-variant succeeded for control traffic with <60ms added tail latency.

Attachments: runbook-replay-log.txt (excerpt below), kv-warmup-report.csv, observability-checklist.pdf

Excerpt from runbook-replay-log.txt:
---
11:00:12 — BRIDGE step 3: ACL verify — OK
11:10:34 — KV warmup start — priming-script.sh (rotate:5m) — running
11:20:16 — KV warmup complete — 98% prefixes hit — median latency 12ms
11:31:02 — FAILOVER test — route switch — control traffic OK
---

Next steps:
- Telemetry team to action OPS-3421 (small alert gap) — Irene will follow up with telemetry lead.
- Acme: please confirm source IPs to be whitelisted; once we have them we’ll record them in runbook and close the loop.

Thanks everyone — good green on the cutover snapshot.

Irene Choi
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
